seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Perris, CA for 2026: THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride, the Christmas Parade and Breakfast with Santa, checked on host sites.
lede: Perris is the Inland Empire's holiday train town, with THE POLAR EXPRESS at the Southern California Railway Museum, a downtown Christmas parade and a city Breakfast with Santa.
celebrates: Perris builds its Christmas season around trains and downtown. The Southern California Railway Museum runs THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride on select dates, a one hour trip with hot chocolate, cookies and a visit from Santa. On Saturday, December 12 the city holds its 36th Annual Christmas Parade along D Street, rain or shine. A week later the Community Services department serves Breakfast with Santa at the Bob Glass Gymnasium, with seatings by registration. The city also holds a tree lighting and a Winter Wonderland with snow play each December.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Perris held its 37th Annual Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony and a Winter Wonderland on Saturday, December 6, from 11 am to 6 pm, according to its calendar archive. Santa came to town for Breakfast with Santa on December 20, 2025, when the city's own post showed residents having breakfast with him. The Southern California Railway Museum also ran its holiday train rides that season.
facts: The Southern California Railway Museum is at 2201 S A Street in Perris and holds over 200 railway vehicles, according to our museum guide. From November 9, 2026 to January 4, 2027 its grounds are open only to THE POLAR EXPRESS ticket holders. The city's Christmas Parade is in its 36th year, and the Christmas Tree Lighting ceremony was in its 37th year in 2025, which makes the holiday season one of the longest running traditions in town.
trains: Trains are the headline in Perris. THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride at the Southern California Railway Museum is a one hour ride set to the movie soundtrack, with dancing chefs, golden tickets and the first gift of Christmas. The whole visit takes about two hours. The museum has a page on our museum guide, and its regular weekend train and trolley rides pick back up in the new year.

The city's 36th Annual Christmas Parade runs along downtown D Street.
The Community Services department holds a seated family breakfast at the Bob Glass Gymnasium.

kidfact: The Polar Express ride in Perris gives every child the first gift of Christmas.
faq: Perris has THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride at the Southern California Railway Museum, a downtown Christmas Parade on D Street, and a city Breakfast with Santa at the Bob Glass Gymnasium. The city also holds a tree lighting and Winter Wonderland in early December.
Is there a Christmas train ride in Perris?

Yes. The Southern California Railway Museum runs THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride on select dates in November and December 2026. Value departures cost $56.25 for adults and $49.25 for children ages 2 to 11.
When is the Perris Christmas Parade in 2026?
The City of Perris holds its 36th Annual Christmas Parade on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at 10 am on the downtown D Street route, rain or shine.
Where can kids meet Santa in Perris?
Kids can meet Santa on THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride at the railway museum and at the city's Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 19 at the Bob Glass Gymnasium, which needs registration.
